grammar: v. 再次使用；重复使用。reuse—reused—reused；名词 reuse 表示再利用，前缀 re- 表示“再、重新”。
collocations: reuse a bottle; reuse old materials; reuse shopping bags; reuse and recycle
commonMistake: reuse 表示把原物再次使用，recycle 表示加工后回收利用；旧瓶直接装水是 reuse，熔化再制则是 recycle。

example.english: We reuse glass jars to store pencils instead of throwing them away.
example.chinese: 我们重复使用玻璃罐来装铅笔，而不是把它们扔掉。

application.prompt: We ___ glass jars to store pencils instead of throwing them away. A. reuse B. refuse
application.solution: A。解析：把旧玻璃罐继续拿来装铅笔是 reuse（重复使用）；refuse 是拒绝。

grammar: v. 回收利用。recycle—recycled—recycled；名词 recycling 表示回收利用这一过程。
collocations: recycle paper; recycle plastic bottles; recycle household waste; recycling bin
commonMistake: recycle 的过去式去掉词尾不发音的 e，再加 -ed：recycled；名词“回收利用”常写 recycling。

example.english: Our school recycles paper and cans in separate bins.
example.chinese: 我们学校把纸张和易拉罐分类回收。

application.prompt: Please ___ the paper rather than put it in the bin for general waste. A. retell B. recycle
application.solution: B。解析：把纸张分类处理以制成可再用材料是 recycle（回收利用）。

grammar: n. 污染；污染物，通常作不可数名词。动词 pollute，形容词 polluted（受污染的）和 polluting（造成污染的）。
collocations: air pollution; water pollution; noise pollution; reduce pollution
commonMistake: pollution 是名词，描述“污染严重”可说 severe pollution；pollute 才是动词，不能说 factories pollution the river。

example.english: Air pollution can make it harder for people with asthma to breathe.
example.chinese: 空气污染会让哮喘患者呼吸更加困难。

application.prompt: The river was closed to swimmers because of severe ___. A. pollution B. pollute
application.solution: A。解析：because of 后接名词 pollution；pollute 是动词，表示“污染”。

grammar: n. 化学品；化学制品；adj. 化学的。名词可数时复数 chemicals；名词化学为 chemistry，化学家为 chemist。
collocations: a dangerous chemical; household chemicals; chemical waste; chemical reaction
commonMistake: chemical 作名词指化学品，chemistry 指学科“化学”；the chemical 可指某一种化学物质。

example.english: The label warns that this chemical can irritate your skin.
example.chinese: 标签警告说，这种化学品可能刺激皮肤。

application.prompt: The label warns that this ___ can irritate your skin. A. chemically B. chemical
application.solution: B。解析：this 后需要名词 chemical，指这种化学品；chemically 是副词。

grammar: n. 烟雾；烟雾污染，通常作不可数名词。由 smoke 与 fog 合成，可说 a thick layer of smog。
collocations: thick smog; smog pollution; a smog alert; reduce smog
commonMistake: smog 特指烟尘造成的污染性烟雾；fog 通常指雾气本身，不能把工厂排放形成的 smog 简单译作普通雾。

example.english: Traffic and factory fumes created a layer of smog over the city.
example.chinese: 交通和工厂废气在城市上空形成了一层烟雾。

application.prompt: The report linked the gray haze over the city to traffic and factory emissions; it was ___. A. smog B. mist
application.solution: A。解析：由交通和工厂排放造成的污染性烟雾是 smog；mist 是薄雾。

grammar: adj. 全球的；全世界的。名词 globe 指地球或球体，副词 globally 表示“在全球范围内”。
collocations: global issues; global market; global population; a global problem
commonMistake: global 是形容词，可说 global warming；globe 是名词，表示地球或球体，不能直接修饰 warming。

example.english: The charity works with schools around the world on global issues.
example.chinese: 这家慈善机构与世界各地的学校合作，关注全球性问题。

application.prompt: The charity works with schools around the world on ___ issues. A. globe B. global
application.solution: B。解析：修饰名词 issues 需要形容词 global（全球的）；globe 是名词。

grammar: 短语名词：全球变暖，通常作不可数名词。global 修饰 warming；讨论成因常用 gases contribute to global warming。
collocations: slow global warming; the effects of global warming; contribute to global warming; tackle global warming
commonMistake: global warming 是固定名词短语；不要漏写 warming 的 -ing，也不要把它拆成 global warm。

example.english: Using less fossil fuel can help slow global warming.
example.chinese: 少用化石燃料有助于减缓全球变暖。

application.prompt: Cutting greenhouse-gas emissions can help slow ___. A. global warming B. global warm
application.solution: A。解析：表示“全球变暖”的固定名词短语是 global warming；warm 不能在此作名词。

grammar: v. 污染；弄脏。pollute—polluted—polluted；名词 pollution，形容词 polluted。
collocations: pollute the air; pollute a river; pollute the environment; heavily polluted
commonMistake: pollute 是动词，句中需按主语和时态变化：smoke pollutes the air；名词“污染”才用 pollution。

example.english: Plastic bags can pollute the sea if people leave them on the beach.
example.chinese: 如果人们把塑料袋留在海滩上，它们就会污染海洋。

application.prompt: Oil spills can ___ the sea and harm wildlife. A. pollution B. pollute
application.solution: B。解析：can 后接动词原形 pollute，表示“污染”海洋；pollution 是名词。

grammar: n. 处置；清理。常用 disposal of sth；动词为 dispose，dispose of 表示“处理、处置”。
collocations: the disposal of waste; waste disposal; safe disposal; at someone's disposal
commonMistake: disposal 是名词，后常接 of；动词搭配则是 dispose of，不能把 disposal of 与 dispose of 混用词性。

example.english: The safe disposal of batteries requires a special collection point.
example.chinese: 电池的安全处置需要专门的回收点。

application.prompt: The safe ___ of batteries requires a special collection point. A. disposal B. dispose
application.solution: A。解析：形容词 safe 后需要名词 disposal；dispose 是动词，通常用 dispose of。

grammar: n. 包裹；包装；v. 把……包装好。package—packaged—packaged；包装材料可说 packaging。
collocations: a package of books; package a gift; package food safely; package design
commonMistake: package 可作名词也可作动词；作动词变过去式时词尾 e 保留后加 -d，写 packaged，不写 packeged。

example.english: The workers packaged the glass carefully before sending it.
example.chinese: 工人们寄出玻璃制品前仔细地把它们包装好。

application.prompt: Yesterday, we ___ the glass carefully before sending it. A. package B. packaged
application.solution: B。解析：Yesterday 表示过去，package 的过去式为 packaged，意为“把……包装好”。

grammar: adj. 自然环境的；生态环境的。名词 environment；副词 environmentally；常作定语修饰问题、保护或组织。
collocations: environmental protection; environmental problems; environmental damage; environmental group
commonMistake: environmental 是形容词，environment 是名词；environmental protection 表示“环境保护”，不能漏掉形容词后缀 -al。

example.english: Our class joined an environmental project to clean the riverbank.
example.chinese: 我们班参加了一个清理河岸的环保项目。

application.prompt: The school invited an ___ expert to speak about waste and climate. A. environmental B. environment
application.solution: A。解析：修饰 expert 要用形容词 environmental；environment 是名词。

grammar: adj. 广为人知的；著名的。常作定语或表语；比较级 better-known，最高级 best-known。
collocations: a well-known writer; well-known for; a well-known fact; become well-known
commonMistake: well-known 作前置定语时通常加连字符；well-known for 后接出名的原因，well-known as 后接身份。

example.english: The well-known scientist gave a talk that attracted reporters.
example.chinese: 这位著名科学家做了一场吸引记者到场的演讲。

application.prompt: The ___ scientist gave a talk that attracted reporters from many newspapers. A. well-know B. well-known
application.solution: B。解析：复合形容词 well-known 的拼写需要词尾 n 和连字符，修饰 scientist。

grammar: v. 打扰；扰乱；使焦虑。disturb—disturbed—disturbed；名词 disturbance，形容词 disturbed/disturbing。
collocations: disturb someone; disturb the peace; be disturbed by noise; a disturbing sight
commonMistake: disturbed 描述人的感受（受到困扰的），disturbing 描述令人不安的事物；不要把两类分词形容词互换。

example.english: Please do not disturb the birds while they are nesting.
example.chinese: 鸟儿筑巢期间，请不要打扰它们。

application.prompt: Please do not ___ the birds while they are nesting. A. disturb B. disturbance
application.solution: A。解析：do not 后接动词原形 disturb；disturbance 是名词。

grammar: n. 陷阱；v. 设陷阱捕捉；使困住。trap—trapped—trapped；现在分词 trapping，词尾辅音 p 双写。
collocations: set a trap; trap an animal; be trapped in a lift; a mouse trap
commonMistake: trap 变过去式或现在分词时要双写 p：trapped、trapping；不要写成 traped 或 traping。

example.english: The mouse was caught in a trap baited with cheese.
example.chinese: 这只老鼠被一个放了奶酪作诱饵的捕鼠夹夹住了。

application.prompt: The mouse was caught in a ___ baited with cheese. A. trapped B. trap
application.solution: B。解析：a 后面需要名词 trap（陷阱）；trapped 是动词过去式或过去分词。

grammar: n. 灯；台灯。可数名词，复数 lamps；常指有灯泡和灯罩的照明器具，lamp 可由 desk、bedside 等修饰。
collocations: a desk lamp; a bedside lamp; switch on a lamp; a lamp shade
commonMistake: lamp 指灯具，light 可指光线或灯；说“挪动台灯”用 lamp，说“房间里没有光”常用 light。

example.english: I moved the desk lamp closer so I could read the small print.
example.chinese: 我把台灯挪近了一些，这样就能看清小字。

application.prompt: Could you move this ___ closer to my book? A. lamp B. lamps
application.solution: A。解析：this 后接单数名词 lamp，指这盏灯；lamps 是复数。

grammar: v. 使烦恼；打扰；费心。常用 bother someone；bother to do sth 表示“费心做某事”。
collocations: bother someone; bother to ask; don't bother; it bothers me that...
commonMistake: bother 作“使某人烦恼”时直接接人作宾语：The noise bothers me；不要说 bothers to me。

example.english: The repeated phone calls began to bother the family during dinner.
example.chinese: 晚餐时，反复打来的电话开始让这一家人心烦。

application.prompt: The repeated phone calls began to ___ the family during dinner. A. bothers B. bother
application.solution: B。解析：begin to 后接动词原形 bother；此处指电话打扰了这一家人。

grammar: n. 丧失；损失；亏损。动词为 lose，过去式 lost；形容词 lost 常表示迷路或失去的。
collocations: a loss of power; suffer a loss; a great loss; loss of life
commonMistake: loss 是名词，lose 是动词：the loss of a key（钥匙的丢失），lose a key（丢钥匙）；不要写成 lose of。

example.english: The sudden loss of electricity stopped the factory's machines.
example.chinese: 突然断电使工厂的机器停了下来。

application.prompt: The sudden ___ of electricity stopped the factory's machines. A. loss B. lose
application.solution: A。解析：the sudden 后需要名词 loss，表示“突然断电”；lose 是动词。

grammar: n. 监护人；保护者；守卫者。可数名词，复数 guardians；动词 guard 表示守卫，名词 guard 也可指警卫。
collocations: a legal guardian; guardian of a child; guardian angel; act as a guardian
commonMistake: guardian 通常指负有保护或监护责任的人；guard 更常指看守者或守卫行为，法律文件中不要混用。

example.english: A legal guardian signed the form for the child.
example.chinese: 一位法定监护人为这个孩子签了表格。

application.prompt: A legal ___ signed the form for the child. A. guard B. guardian
application.solution: B。解析：替孩子签署法定文件的人是 guardian（监护人）；guard 通常指警卫。

grammar: adj. 有难闻气味的。由 smell + -y 构成；比较级 smellier，最高级 smelliest，变形时 y 改为 i。
collocations: smelly socks; smelly rubbish; a smelly fish; smell bad
commonMistake: smelly 是形容词，smell 可作名词或动词；比较级写 smellier，不写 more smelly 在基础词形题中容易漏掉 y 的变化。

example.english: We threw away the smelly fish that had been left in the sun.
example.chinese: 我们把那条被遗忘在太阳下、已经发臭的鱼扔掉了。

application.prompt: We threw away the ___ fish because it had been left in the sun. A. smelly B. smell
application.solution: A。解析：修饰 fish 需要形容词 smelly，描述鱼有难闻的气味；smell 在此是名词或动词。

grammar: n. 禁令；v. 明令禁止。ban—banned—banned；现在分词 banning，词尾 n 双写。
collocations: ban plastic bags; impose a ban on; a smoking ban; be banned from doing sth
commonMistake: ban 的过去式和现在分词都双写 n：banned、banning；名词搭配常用 a ban on sth。

example.english: The city plans to ban plastic bags in supermarkets next year.
example.chinese: 市政府计划明年禁止超市使用塑料袋。

application.prompt: The city plans to ___ plastic bags in supermarkets next year. A. ban B. banned
application.solution: A。解析：plan to 后接动词原形 ban，表示“禁止”；banned 是过去式或过去分词。

grammar: n. 河岸；河堤。可数，复数 riverbanks；也可分写为 river bank。
collocations: a muddy riverbank; sit on the riverbank; along the riverbank; riverbank plants
commonMistake: riverbank 是河流两侧的岸地；riverbed 指河床，位于河水流经的底部，二者位置不同。

example.english: We sat on the riverbank and watched the boats pass.
example.chinese: 我们坐在河岸边看船只经过。

application.prompt: A path followed the river's edge along the muddy ___. A. riverbed B. riverbank
application.solution: B。解析：沿河边的小路在泥泞的河岸 riverbank 上；riverbed 是水下的河床。

examTags: 词汇·形容词与副词派生
grammar: adj. 稳定的；持续的；平稳的。副词 steadily；比较级 steadier，最高级 steadiest。
collocations: steady progress; a steady increase; keep a steady pace; hold something steady
commonMistake: steady 作名词前定语或宾语补足语时用形容词，如 steady progress、hold it steady；steadily 才修饰动词。

example.english: She has made steady progress in reading throughout the term.
example.chinese: 整个学期里，她的阅读水平稳步提高。

application.prompt: She has made ___ progress in reading all term. A. steadiness B. steady
application.solution: B。解析：修饰名词 progress 需要形容词 steady；steadiness 是名词“稳定性”。

grammar: n. 收入；收益。通常作不可数名词；表示个人或家庭收入时可说 monthly income 或 income from a job。
collocations: monthly income; a steady income; income tax; earn an income
commonMistake: income 通常不可数，不说 an income 或 incomes 表示一个人的收入；需要强调不同来源时才可能用复数。

example.english: Her monthly income covers rent, food, and bus fares.
example.chinese: 她每月的收入足以支付房租、食物和公交车费。

application.prompt: Her monthly ___ covers rent, food, and bus fares. A. income B. incoming
application.solution: A。解析：支付各项开支的钱是 income（收入）；incoming 常作形容词，表示“即将到来的”。

examTags: 语法·动词短语与名词辨析
grammar: n. 清扫；清理；善后。常用于 a clean-up；动词短语 clean up 表示打扫或清理，书写时不加连字符。
collocations: a beach clean-up; a community clean-up; organize a clean-up; clean up a river
commonMistake: 名词 clean-up 常带连字符，动词短语 clean up 分写：join a clean-up，但 clean up the beach。

example.english: The community organized a beach clean-up after the storm.
example.chinese: 暴风雨过后，社区组织了一次海滩清理活动。

application.prompt: After the storm, the volunteers planned a ___ of the beach. A. cleanly B. clean-up
application.solution: B。解析：a 后需要名词 clean-up（清理活动）；cleanly 是副词，不能作此处的宾语。

grammar: n. 一代人；产生；发电。可数，复数 generations；动词 generate，形容词 generational。
collocations: the younger generation; future generations; a generation gap; power generation
commonMistake: generation 是名词，可说 the next generation；generate 是动词“产生”，不要把动词原形放在冠词后。

example.english: This generation grew up with smartphones and online classes.
example.chinese: 这一代人伴随着智能手机和线上课程成长。

application.prompt: The next ___ may have different ideas about travel. A. generation B. generating
application.solution: A。解析：the next 后需要名词 generation，指“下一代人”；generating 是动名词或现在分词。

grammar: n. 保护；保护物。动词 protect，过去式 protected；形容词 protective（保护性的）、protected（受保护的）。
collocations: environmental protection; eye protection; protection from the sun; under someone's protection
commonMistake: protection 是名词，protect 是动词；provide protection from danger 中 from 引出保护所针对的危险。

example.english: Sunglasses provide eye protection from strong sunlight.
example.chinese: 太阳镜可以保护眼睛免受强烈阳光照射。

application.prompt: Sunglasses provide eye ___ from strong sunlight. A. protect B. protection
application.solution: B。解析：eye 后需要名词 protection；protect 是动词“保护”。

grammar: n. 轮胎。英式拼写 tyre，美式拼写 tire；复数 tyres/tires。作动词 tire 表示“使疲劳”，拼写相同但含义不同。
collocations: a flat tyre; change a tyre; a tyre pressure; a spare tyre
commonMistake: tyre 是英式英语中“轮胎”的拼法，tire 是美式拼法；两者都正确，需按文章采用的英语变体保持一致。

example.english: The car stopped because one tyre had lost all its air.
example.chinese: 汽车停了下来，因为有一个轮胎完全没气了。

application.prompt: The mechanic replaced the punctured rubber ___ around the wheel. A. tyre B. wheel
application.solution: A。解析：车轮外侧被扎破的橡胶部分是 tyre（英式“轮胎”）；wheel 指车轮整体。

grammar: v. 埋葬；掩埋；埋头于。bury—buried—buried；现在分词 burying。
collocations: bury a bone; bury treasure; be buried in a book; bury one's face in one's hands
commonMistake: bury 变过去式时 y 改为 i 再加 -ed：buried；在 to bury 中保留原形 y。

example.english: The dog began to bury its bone in the soft soil.
example.chinese: 那只狗开始把骨头埋进松软的土里。

application.prompt: The dog began to ___ its bone in the soft soil. A. buried B. bury
application.solution: B。解析：begin to 后接动词原形 bury；buried 是过去式或过去分词。

grammar: n. 垃圾填埋场；垃圾填埋。可数时复数 landfills；垃圾被送去填埋常说 be sent to a landfill。
collocations: a landfill site; send waste to landfill; landfill waste; landfill gas
commonMistake: landfill 是废弃物填埋的场所或处理方式；landform 指地貌，二者虽共享 land 但词义不同。

example.english: Waste that cannot be recycled is often sent to a landfill.
example.chinese: 无法回收的垃圾通常会被送往填埋场。

application.prompt: Most waste that cannot be recycled is sent to a ___. A. landfill B. landform
application.solution: A。解析：无法回收的垃圾会送去 landfill（垃圾填埋场）；landform 指地貌。

grammar: 短语动词：leave sth behind，把某物遗忘在某处或留下；若宾语是代词，必须放在 leave 与 behind 之间：leave it behind。
collocations: leave a bag behind; leave someone behind; leave the past behind; leave it behind
commonMistake: leave behind 后接代词时要说 leave it behind，不能说 leave behind it；名词宾语两种位置都常见。

example.english: I left my umbrella behind on the bus yesterday.
example.chinese: 我昨天把伞落在公交车上了。

application.prompt: Check your seat before getting off the bus so you don't ___ your bag. A. leave out B. leave behind
application.solution: B。解析：下车时把包忘在车上是 leave behind；leave out 表示遗漏或排除。

grammar: 短语动词：come up with sth，想出主意或提出方案；come 是不规则动词，过去式 came，过去分词 come。
collocations: come up with an idea; come up with a plan; come up with a solution; come up with a name
commonMistake: come up with 表示“想出、提出”，with 后接想出的内容；come up to 则常表示“达到标准”，意义不同。

example.english: The class came up with a practical way to save water.
example.chinese: 全班想出了一个节约用水的实用办法。

application.prompt: The team needed to ___ a plan before the deadline. A. come up with B. come up to
application.solution: A。解析：在截止日期前“想出”计划用 come up with；come up to 常表示达到标准。

grammar: adj. 户外的；室外的，通常作定语。对应副词短语 outdoors（在户外）；反义词 indoor。
collocations: outdoor activities; an outdoor concert; outdoor furniture; outdoor sports
commonMistake: outdoor 作形容词放在名词前，如 outdoor activities；表示“在户外”作副词时用 outdoors，不说 stay outdoor。

example.english: The school canceled the outdoor concert because of heavy rain.
example.chinese: 学校因大雨取消了户外音乐会。

application.prompt: The school canceled the ___ concert because of heavy rain. A. outdoors B. outdoor
application.solution: B。解析：修饰名词 concert 要用形容词 outdoor；outdoors 是副词“在户外”。

grammar: 短语动词 wash up：英式英语中可指洗餐具；也可指被水冲到岸上。美式英语常用 wash up 表示洗手。
collocations: wash up the dishes; wash the plates up; wash up before dinner; be washed up on the beach
commonMistake: 宾语是代词时放在 wash 与 up 中间：wash them up；若表示物品被水冲上岸，常用被动 be washed up on shore。

example.english: After dinner, we washed up the plates and stacked them by the sink.
example.chinese: 晚饭后，我们洗好盘子，把它们叠放在水槽旁。

application.prompt: After dinner, we ___ the plates and stacked them by the sink. A. washed up B. washed out
application.solution: A。解析：晚饭后清洗盘子用 wash up；wash out 通常表示洗净内部、冲掉或洗掉。

grammar: n. 垃圾箱；有盖的大容器。可数，复数 bins；英式英语常用 bin 表示垃圾桶，美式英语常说 trash can。
collocations: a recycling bin; a rubbish bin; put something in the bin; wheelie bin
commonMistake: bin 是容器名词，put sth in the bin 表示把东西扔进垃圾桶；动词 bind（捆绑）多一个 d，意思不同。

example.english: Put the empty bottle in the recycling bin by the door.
example.chinese: 把空瓶放进门边的回收箱里。

application.prompt: Put the empty bottle in the recycling ___ beside the door. A. bind B. bin
application.solution: B。解析：放空瓶的回收容器是 bin（箱、桶）；bind 是动词“捆绑”。
